set(incs .)

set(srcs ap_main.c key_map.c ui/doorbell_ui.c ui/ui_home_feed_img.c )

if (CONFIG_AUD_PARAM_CTRL)
    list(APPEND incs ./audio_param)
    list(APPEND srcs audio_param/audio_para.c)
endif()

# UI-only sources generated by the Beken LVGL Designer tool. beken_generated.cmake
# globs all *.c recursively and collects include dirs, so the generated UI can be
# replaced as a whole directory after re-exporting from the PC tool.
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/beken_generated/beken_generated.cmake)

# The Designer exported the home-page camera mockup as a full 1024x1536 RGB565A8
# C bitmap (~4.5MB in flash). RGB565A8 does not fit even after resizing OTA, so
# drop the generated file and link ui/ui_home_feed_img.c instead: the SAME symbol
# re-encoded as plain RGB565 (~3.0MB; the alpha plane was fully opaque, dropped),
# which fits once the AP partition is enlarged (see partitions/bk7259). home_init.c
# stays unchanged. Regenerate ui_home_feed_img.c after re-exporting the UI.
list(FILTER BEKEN_GENERATOR_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "door_cam_1024x1536_RGB565A8_NONE")

list(APPEND srcs ${BEKEN_GENERATOR_SOURCES})
list(APPEND incs ${BEKEN_GENERATOR_INCLUDE_DIRS})

set(priv_req
    multimedia_device_service
    avdk_utils
    media_service
    smart_intercom
    bk_network_transfer
    lwip_intf_v2_1
    bk_wifi_driver
    bk_peripheral
    lcd_device
    boot_video_player
    boot_image_player
    doorbell_netcfg
    lvgl
    bk_key
    bk_factory_config
)

armino_component_register(SRCS "${srcs}" INCLUDE_DIRS "${incs}" PRIV_REQUIRES "${priv_req}")

# NOTE: must be AFTER armino_component_register. The component CMakeLists is also
# included in a non-scriptable "requirements scan" pass where set_source_files_
# properties is unavailable; armino_component_register returns early in that pass,
# so placing this here keeps it out of the scan.
#
# The Designer-generated event callbacks may declare unused locals (bk_ui/target)
# on pages whose buttons are not wired. Keep the generated sources byte-for-byte
# replaceable by relaxing those specific warnings to non-fatal for them only,
# instead of editing the generated code.
set_source_files_properties(${BEKEN_GENERATOR_SOURCES}
    PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS
    "-Wno-error=unused-variable;-Wno-error=unused-but-set-variable")
